title: Gizemli Hikaye Küpleri: Kütüphanedeki Tehlike
author: Fatih Cem Gülbent
description: This time, Deniz finds himself in the Library of Forgotten Books, where his mission is to both save the flower of life and protect the library from flooding. Join the excitement, venture through the magical corridors, follow the compass, and try to reach the heart of the story. Remember, every choice will lead you to a different adventure!
english_title: Mysterious Story Cubes: Danger at the Library
